source: 2012/TSB Vol 12 No 2 Important Brake Service Announcement 2-17-12.pdf
title: Brake Service Announcement Draining the Master Cylinder
lead: : It has been brought to our attention that removing all the fluid from the brake fluid reservoir, while doing a brake fluid flush service, can possibly lead to air in the brake system.
body: It is our recommendation that you leave at least a ½" of fluid in the reservoir when evacuating the old fluid at the beginning of the service.
